findings.heading: Major revisions / Principais revisões
findings.proposition: The English revisions table states that version 1.0.1 was released on 20 Nov 2022; the Portuguese table lists only the 10 May 2021 release of version 1.0.0.
findings.reader_consequence: A Portuguese reader concludes the newest handbook version is 1.0.0 from May 2021, does not know a later 1.0.1 release exists, and cannot tell which version the text they are reading corresponds to.

findings.heading: Major revisions / Principais revisões
findings.proposition: The English has a NEWS block listing the ten changes implemented in version 1.0.1 (update to R 4.2; Data cleaning switched {linelist} to {matchmaker} and removed a line from the `case_when()` example; Dates switched {linelist} `guess_date()` to {parsedate} `parse_date()`; Pivoting update to `pivot_wider()` `id_cols=`; Survey analysis switched `plot_age_pyramid()` to `age_pyramid()` plus an alluvial plot code change; Heat plots added `ungroup()` to the `agg_weeks` chunk; Interactive plots added `ungroup()` so `expand()` works; Time series added `data.frame()` inside all `trending::fit()` and `predict()` calls; Combinations analysis switched `case_when()` to `ifelse()` and added optional `across()` code; Transmission chains updated to a newer {epicontacts}); the Portuguese chapter has no NEWS block at all.
findings.reader_consequence: A Portuguese reader gets no changelog: they will not know that the handbook targets R 4.2, that {linelist} was replaced by {matchmaker} and {parsedate}, or that several chunks changed, so they cannot reconcile older code they copied earlier with the current text and cannot judge whether their Portuguese pages are up to date.
